note: Load form (research/load-harness.md) for L11: each step restarts the twin, then sends one route at 5 requests a second; the judged quantity is the slowest response. Work deferred to the first request (a lazily built table, a template compiled on first use, a client opened on demand) makes the first response, and those queued behind it, slow; work done at startup does not. A twin reports at five times the other's slowest response and at least 80 ms. The price and order routes start the same in both twins: the decoys. Each step runs at a fixed arrival rate (k6), each twin judged against the other over 3 repeats, every finding under the timing rule. defects are what the planted twin must report and the clean twin must not; every other judged step is a decoy, in both twins.
